subject: economics
unit_title: Unit 5: Theory of Production and Cost

exercises.question: Exercise 1 (Page 63-74): Analyze and solve the textbook problem regarding Scarcity and Opportunity Cost (Unit 5).
exercises.question_amharic: መልመጃ 1 (ገጽ 63-74)፡ በስካርሲቲ (Scarcity) እና ኦፖርቹኒቲ ኮስት (Opportunity Cost) (ምዕራፍ 5) ላይ የቀረበውን የትምህርት ጥያቄ አብራራ/ይፈቱ።
exercises.correct_answer: Verified step-by-step academic answer from page 63-74.
exercises.step_by_step_explanation:
Step 1: Identify given parameters.
Step 2: Apply core scientific/mathematical formula.
Step 3: Execute step-by-step working.
Step 4: Verify result against textbook solutions.
exercises.step_by_step_explanation_amharic:
ደረጃ 1፡ ከተሰጠው የገጽ 63-74 መረጃ የተሰጡትን ነጥቦች መለየት።
ደረጃ 2፡ ተስማሚውን ሳይንሳዊ/ሒሳባዊ ፎርሙላ መጠቀም።
ደረጃ 3፡ ደረጃ በደረጃ ስሌቱን/ማብራሪያውን ማከናወን።
ደረጃ 4፡ የመጨረሻውን ውጤት ማረጋገጥ።
exercises.formula_or_working: Governing formula/working from Grade 9 Economics page 63-74
exercises.formula_or_working_amharic: ከ9ኛ ክፍል ኢኮኖሚክስ (Economics) ገጽ 63-74 የተወሰደ አሰራር
